description: First real verification: format recovered, semantic gate correctly remained blocking; final rejection distinguished normal from optional blinking. Preserve exact qualifier when revising, audit all omissions together. No image submission.

missingBaseConditions: Crisp pixel palette must be preserved explicitly.

receipts.prompt: Native pixel dog, north in every frame including final hold; north means REAR, away from camera. Rear head only, no shoulder glance, no visible eyes, nose, mouth or chest. Chest breath <=1px; blink optional. Fixed unchanged head silhouette, outline, tail, coat markings, paws, coat, eyes and native pixel size; crisp palette; fixed camera; no props or text. Every frame: approved pose stable; no appendage, attached feature, pose or rear silhouette position or shape changes beyond subtle breathing or blinking; minor breathing and blinking allowed. Idle visually still; no repeated appendage movement, wag cycle or bob. Keep seed tail shape and position fixed; if hidden, keep hidden; never add a tail above head or ears, crown or antenna. Hidden front tail stays behind body; side/rear tails stay complete and connected in approved pose. Use the entire transparent 40x40 canvas; keep two clear pixels at every edge, all paws and tail complete. No cropping, shrinking, blur or detached parts. Loop smoothly to the initial pose.
